start_here: Say to your AI: "Stop that run of my workflow, it is not needed." It asks tool:workflow-run-cancel with the run's key, and its waiting tasks are withdrawn so a later answer is refused.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it withdraws the run's own waiting tasks and cancels its schedule.
instructions: 1. Find the run's key: tool:workflow-run-show returns each run's run_key with its tasks.

2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:workflow-run-cancel and input {run_key, caller, database, why?}; caller is your AI's record id (the run's starter).
3. Read result: withdrawn is the number of waiting tasks stopped; cancelled says whether the live step was cancelled on the engine.
4. Refused, and nothing is changed, when the run does not record who started it or caller is not that starter.

worked_examples.title: Stop a run that is waiting for an answer
worked_examples.ask: Stop the run that is waiting on the port-old-code step, it is not needed.
worked_examples.hands_back: result {run_key, withdrawn: 1, cancelled: true}; the step's task reads Withdrawn and a later answer is refused.
